scientific_integrity: Original analytic derivation from an exact phase-plane energy identity. Symbolic algebra spot-check corroborates coefficients, not infinite convergence. No third-party full-text reproduced.
scientific_limitations: Real positive states with \(p>3\) only; the finite-part constant \(K\) depends on initial data and is not given in closed form. An equivalent specialized damped-ODE asymptotic may exist in unindexed literature.
title: Critical quintic logarithm and finite-part energy in exponential-memory blow-up
